as_told.title: Spergel of the Simons Foundation chairs the NASA UAP working group

plain: In 2022 NASA, the US space agency, set up an independent panel to study UAP, or unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. The man chosen to lead it was the scientist David Spergel, who also headed the Simons Foundation, the science charity of the billionaire Jim Simons. The analyst Matthew Pines lays this out in a 2024 episode: Spergel "was tapped to be the chair of the NASA UAP working group", and the same account appears again in a 2025 episode. Michels returns to it in at least four episodes. In one he puts it as a question, asking whether the panel's leader "might have any ties to Jim Simons", and he credits the researcher Eric Weinstein for drawing his attention to the link. In other episodes Michels adds that Simons founded Renaissance Technologies, an investment firm, and calls Spergel Simons' "principal scientific advisor". The tellers raise the point because, if the link matters, the panel may not have been as independent as it was presented. None of them goes further than pointing out the connection.
